record.bible_text: The LORD<WH03068> reigneth<WH04427><WTH8804>, he is clothed<WH03847><WTH8804> with majesty<WH01348>; the LORD<WH03068> is clothed<WH03847><WTH8804> with strength<WH05797>, <FI>wherewith<Fi> he hath girded<WH0247><WTH8694> himself: the world<WH08398> also is stablished<WH03559><WTH8735>, that it cannot be moved<WH04131><WTH8735>.
